answer: Every claim climbs the zenith of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ledge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the echo is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, reduced by each unverified claim, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
